visual.general_description: Clinical timeline of eight labeled hospital and follow-up days (Day 1 through Day 105) along a right-pointing arrow, with short text entries above and below.
visual.detailed_description: A horizontal light gray-blue arrow pointing right carries eight dark blue circles in a row, each with a printed "Day" label just above the circle: Day 1, Day 1, Day 2, Day 3, Day 9, Day 24, Day 62, Day 105. Short black serif text blocks sit above the arrow for the first, third, fifth and seventh circles and below the arrow for the second, fourth, sixth and eighth circles, alternating. The printed entries describe: presentation to an outside hospital with low Na and high K; transfer to the PICU in compensated shock with fluid and blood resuscitation, CAH ruled out and ceftriaxone started; Day 2 sodium normalizing on IV fluids, E. Coli on urine culture and a PHA diagnosis after a high aldosterone level; Day 3 repeating those items plus a switch to cephalexin, renal ultrasound showing left hydroureteronephrosis, left iliac thrombus diagnosed and enoxaparin started; Day 9 target anti-Xa levels achieved, antibiotics switched to sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim and discharge with a 1.2 kg weight gain; Day 24 endocrinology follow-up with a normal aldosterone level; Day 62 urology follow-up with a normal VCUG and stable left moderate hydroureteronephrosis on ultrasound; Day 105 hematology follow-up with the clot resolved and enoxaparin discontinued. The "E. Coli" in the Day 2 block is printed in italics. No calendar dates, names, identifiers, images of the patient or numeric axes are visible. The picture is a low-resolution raster.

charts.title: Timeline

measured_quantities.visual_cue: Eight "Day N" labels on circles along an arrow, each with a short text entry

readings.visual_cue: Printed label "Day 1" on a dark circle with its text block above the arrow, first node
readings.value_text: Day 1: Patient presents to outside hospital for loose stools and poor weight gain. Labs reveal low Na and high K.

readings.visual_cue: Printed label "Day 1" on a dark circle with its text block below the arrow, second node
readings.value_text: Day 1: Transferred to PICU in compensated shock. Fluid and blood resuscitation given. Labs rule out CAH. Started on ceftriaxone.

readings.visual_cue: Printed label "Day 2" on a dark circle with its text block above the arrow, third node
readings.value_text: Day 2: Sodium normalizes on IV fluids. E. Coli grows on urine culture. Diagnosed with PHA after high aldosterone level.

readings.visual_cue: Printed label "Day 3" on a dark circle with its text block below the arrow, fourth node
readings.value_text: Day 3: Sodium normalizes on IV fluids. E Coli grows on urine culture. Diagnosed with PHA after high aldosterone level. Antibiotics switched to cephalexin. Renal ultrasound shows left hydroureteronephrosis. Left iliac thrombus diagnosed. Enoxaparin started.

readings.visual_cue: Printed label "Day 9" on a dark circle with its text block above the arrow, fifth node
readings.value_text: Day 9: Target anti-Xa levels achieved. Antibiotics switched to sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim. Patient discharged with 1.2 kg weight gain.

readings.visual_cue: Printed label "Day 24" on a dark circle with its text block below the arrow, sixth node
readings.value_text: Day 24: Follow-up with Endocrinology. Normal aldosterone level.

readings.visual_cue: Printed label "Day 62" on a dark circle with its text block above the arrow, seventh node
readings.value_text: Day 62: Follow up with Urology. VCUG normal. Ultrasound with stable left moderate hydroureteronephrosis.

readings.visual_cue: Printed label "Day 105" on a dark circle with its text block below the arrow, eighth node
readings.value_text: Day 105: Follow-up with Hematology. Clot resolved. Enoxaparin discontinued.

limitations: Day labels are printed hospital/follow-up days; the arrow spacing is not a scaled time axis and is not read as such.
